_comment: Facts the content and outreach agents may use. Anything starting with NEED must be filled in by a person; agents never invent it. Source: www.tutorsala.com, read 2026-11-03.
one_liner: Tutorsala runs your tuition center for about the fee of one student: enquiries, batches and class schedules, attendance, fees, WhatsApp parent updates and a parent portal.
positioning: An operations platform for tuition centers, not an LMS. Teaching stays on Zoom or Meet; Tutorsala runs the business around it.
audience: Independent tutors, coaching centres and academies in India running batches of students
value_props: Education CRM: capture enquiries from your website, WhatsApp and walk-ins, run demos and enrol students in one pipeline
Academy OS: batches, schedules, attendance, tests and tutors in one place
Parent communication: automated WhatsApp, email and SMS when attendance drops or test results are posted, plus a parent portal
Fees: see fees due and paid, monthly or per-class, without chasing anyone on the phone. Tuition is collected on your own UPI or bank
Student success: track homework, skills, interventions and progress, not just grades
Business intelligence: KPIs, trends and daily decisions, so you know what to do next
AI assistants for owners, tutors, parents and students: insights and message drafts
Setup done with you on a call: batches, teachers and fees added and students imported from Excel. Nothing to install
Marketplace listing so parents can find your center and send an enquiry

pricing.starter: Rs 18,000/year (launch offer, 50% off Rs 36,000): 1 branch, up to 100 active students. About Rs 1,500 a month
pricing.multi_branch: + Rs 12,000 per branch per year (50% off Rs 24,000), + Rs 30 per student per year above 100 per branch
pricing.note: GST may apply on the platform fee

proof_points_note: NEED: real customer count, testimonial or result. The website shows none yet, so no proof may be used.
offer: Free 30-day design-partner pilot (limited early centers), set up with you on a call. Then Starter at the 50% launch price.
cta: Book a free demo (www.tutorsala.com/start-page.html) or message on WhatsApp

voice.tone: Warm, practical, teacher-to-teacher. Short sentences. No hype.

content_pillars: Fill your batches (admissions and marketing tips)
